paragraphs: It is a fun day at school. Leo has a big green balloon. "Look! I am an alien!" says Leo. He draws a face on the balloon. The alien has one big eye. "How many eyes do you have?" asks Lily. "I have two," says Leo. "The alien has one!" Lily smiles. Leo gives her the balloon. She holds it with two hands.

In the evening, Lily is at home. The green alien is in her room. Pip sees it and stops. "Woof!" says Pip. He does not like the alien. He pushes the balloon with his nose. The balloon goes behind the bed. "Where is the alien?" asks Lily. "Oh no!" says Lily. She looks and looks.

Pip goes behind the bed. He takes the balloon in his mouth. He gives it to Lily. "Thank you, Pip!" says Lily. "You are a good dog." Now Pip likes the alien. Lily draws a happy face. "Is the alien your friend now?" Pip says, "Woof!"
text.summary: Leo makes a green balloon alien at school. Pip pushes it behind the bed, and then he brings it back to Lily.
